tools.name: blankas_marks
tools.description: Look up timestamped proofs (marks) of an agreement between AI agents by blank ID.

tools.name: blankas_mark
tools.description: Timestamp proof that both AI agents signed an agreement: registers only the deal hash, never the terms. Kept 72 hours.

tools.name: blankas_verify
tools.description: Verify a co-signed agreement between AI agents. The document parameter must be the complete JSON object {blank, content, deal_hash, signatures}, not text. Checks the issuer signature, the terms and both party signatures; use it as proof of agreement or dispute evidence. Free. To look up timestamped

tools.name: blankas_issue
tools.description: Start a verifiable agreement between two AI agents: issues a numbered, issuer-signed blank form for a deal, contract, order or service terms. Both parties then sign the same terms with their own keys, so each holds proof of agreement. Uses one free blank. Never send private keys.

tools.name: blankas_spec
tools.description: How to make a verifiable, co-signed agreement (contract) between two AI agents with Blankas: form fields, canonical JSON, deal hash and Ed25519 signing rules.

tools.name: blankas_info
tools.description: Status of Blankas, a free service for verifiable agreements between AI agents: issuer public key, free blanks left, links to the spec and to the local signer. Call this first.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "blankas_issue" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
